description.value: The Gastown Hostel, part of The Cambie Hostels group, occupies a century-old building in Vancouver's historic Gastown neighbourhood and has been welcoming international travelers for decades. Guests share access to full kitchens, communal lounges, and multiple on-site bars including The Cambie Bar & Grill and Malone's Taphouse. A fob-secured single entrance and 24-hour front desk give the property a notably secure feel for a social hostel.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content from cambiehostels.com clearly identifies the Gastown location at 310 Cambie Street with a matching local phone (+1 604-684-6466 on the contact page) and email. The site describes general security (single fob-protected entrance, 24-hour front desk, cameras, lockers, luggage storage) but makes no explicit mention of bike-specific storage or bike-handling procedures. The FAQ explicitly notes 'rather steep sets of stairs in our century-old buildings,' which may preclude bringing bicycles indoors.
concerns: No bike-specific storage mentioned on the website; general security references (lockers, luggage storage) cover personal belongings only, not bicycles.
FAQ states 'we cannot accommodate some guests with limited mobility, we have rather steep sets of stairs in our century-old buildings,' suggesting bringing bikes indoors may be impractical.

Website front page lists a toll-free number (+1 877-395-5335) as the primary Gastown contact number, while the contact page correctly shows the local number (+1 604-684-6466) that matches OSM; both appear to reach the same property.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate, operating hostel in a cyclist-relevant downtown location, but neither secure bike storage nor staff bike-handling procedures are mentioned anywhere on the website. The building's 'rather steep sets of stairs' noted in the FAQ may also make indoor bicycle access impractical; direct confirmation of bike storage is needed before listing.
